title: hive-rule expire: request body
description: Records that a rule's expiry time was noticed and honoured, with the receipt that says so. The resolver excluded the rule from its expiry time on, before this; the receipt records that the expiry was noticed, not that it took effect. Refused before the expiry time, and idempotent after a first record.

noticed_at.description: When the owning supervisor noticed it, from the wake it drained.

wake.description: The wake record drained, where the Shadow wrote one.
